captions: แล้วโทรศัพท์ก็สั่น

shots.action: Kong is putting the phone away when it buzzes in his glove: the light jumps back onto his face, his eyes go to it.

shots.cut_on: จอสว่างวาบ

captions: จอสว่างวาบ
กลางความมืด

shots.action: The dark street: one small bright rectangle on Kong's chest is the only light in the frame and throws his shadow up the pier; three heads turn to it; he cups his glove over it and it shrinks to a slit.
The incoming call: avatar, น้ำเหนือ, ลูกสาว; the frame buzzes; his thumb swipes to answer and the call timer starts.

shots.cut_on: พ่ออยู่ไหน!

captions: พ่ออยู่ไหน!

shots.action: Kong, phone to his ear (`phone_ear`, elbow out), mouth shut, eyes wide: he listens. The captions carry her words.

captions: ขึ้นรถอพยพ
บอกว่าจะไปท่าเรือ

shots.action: Past Kong's ear and the glowing edge of the phone: Praew and James have stopped and watch him, hearing the small voice; Tos stands apart at the pier, arms crossed. Nobody moves but for breath and the drips.

captions: พ่ออย่าผิดสัญญานะ

shots.action: Call screen: timer 00:11, 00:12; the signal bars fall 2, 1, 0; 'สัญญาณอ่อน' appears.

shots.cut_on: ก้องยังไม่ทันรับปาก

captions: ก้องยังไม่ทันรับปาก

shots.action: Kong's mouth opens to answer ('พ่อ' formed, no sound comes).

shots.cut_on: สัญญาณก็ขาด

captions: สัญญาณก็ขาด

shots.action: The screen: สายหลุด, ไม่มีสัญญาณ; then it dims to black with his reflection drawn in it.

shots.cut_on: ก้องหันหลัง

captions: ก้องหันหลัง
จะไปหาลูกเดี๋ยวนั้น

shots.action: Kong turns, the dark phone still in his left fist, and strides away right, alone (walk cycle, long step); Praew takes two quick steps after him and catches his pack strap.

shots.cut_on: ถ้าคุณไปคนเดียว

captions: ถ้าคุณไปคนเดียว

shots.action: Praew, low and firm (`stern`), still holding the strap.

shots.cut_on: คุณอาจไปไม่ถึงลูก

captions: คุณอาจไปไม่ถึงลูก

shots.action: Reverse, Kong's eyes only: wet, fixed past her on the dark; the last four words land on him and he stops pulling.

shots.cut_on: ก้องกำโทรศัพท์แน่น

captions: ก้องกำโทรศัพท์แน่น

shots.action: His glove closing hard on the dark phone.

shots.cut_on: แล้วเดินตามเจมส์ไป

captions: แล้วเดินตามเจมส์ไป

shots.action: Long view along the piers: four figures in single file keeping to the black side of the street, James leading, Kong last, walking right toward a pale glow at the far end.
